crossRefs.note: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will…
In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.
At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of Yahweh’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.
Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after…

translations.web: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
translations.bsb: God told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
translations.kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
translations.asv: And God spake on this wise, that his seed should sojourn in a strange land, and that they should bring them into bondage, and treat them ill, four hundred years.
